items.title: Add shared local baseline layer schema and suite aggregation for Baseline 2-5
items.context: Local node bin/lattice.js currently lacks baseline_run / baseline_suite_report even though the global CLI exposes them. Add repo-local, typed behavior with shared artifact contracts instead of relying on global install drift.
items.userSees: `node bin/lattice.js help` lists local Baseline commands, and `node bin/lattice.js baseline_suite_report --help` shows shared layer/report arguments instead of unknown command.

happy.desc: After build, local `node bin/lattice.js help` lists `baseline_run`, `baseline_suite`, `baseline_suite_report`, and `capability_claim_evaluate`; `baseline_suite_report --help` shows local schema arguments instead of unknown command.

edge.desc: Unsupported layer or baseline id returns a structured block/error and never synthesizes PASS.

adversarial.desc: Malformed, mixed-schema, or stale artifacts are rejected by the suite/claim path instead of being silently aggregated.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run build && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Build passed and lattice-baseline-smoke verified local CLI help lists baseline_run, baseline_suite, baseline_suite_report, capability_claim_evaluate and baseline_suite_report --help works.
Smoke verified unsupported baseline id fails closed without synthesizing PASS.
Smoke verified malformed, mixed-schema, stale, and authority-overclaim final reports are rejected by suite aggregation.

items.title: Implement Engineering Baseline runner and report generation
items.context: Support ENG-* baseline ids, required expected outcomes, local artifact generation under .omx/artifacts/baseline/engineering, and suite acceptance with Development baseline entry gate.
items.userSees: A developer can run an Engineering baseline command and inspect `.omx/artifacts/baseline/engineering/.../final-report.json` plus an engineering suite report with PASS or expected gated outcome.

happy.desc: Running an Engineering baseline such as `ENG-BUGFIX-1` writes an engineering final-report JSON with expected PASS, scope/regression/evidence fields, and local authority boundary fields false.

edge.desc: High-risk Engineering baselines such as `ENG-DATA-MIGRATION-1` and `ENG-AUTH-SECURITY-1` produce EXPECTED_BLOCK or require explicit gate evidence, not ungated PASS.

adversarial.desc: Missing scope/regression evidence, changed files outside contract, or stale output prevents Engineering suite PASS and records a specific blocked reason.

verificationEvidence.note: Command produced an Engineering final-report for ENG-BUGFIX-1 with outcome PASS, expectedOutcome PASS, required artifacts, and authority fields false.
Smoke covers high-risk/gated baseline behavior through fail-closed expected-block scenarios and verifies no ungated PASS is synthesized.

verificationEvidence.command: node packages/main/dist/cli.js baseline_suite_report --layer=engineering --format=json && npm --prefix packages/main run test:lattice-baseline-smoke
verificationEvidence.note: Suite report stayed BLOCKED/not_authorized when lower-layer Development proof and required ENG reports were missing; smoke rejects stale, malformed, and authority-overclaim reports.

items.title: Implement Loop Engineering Baseline runner and fail-closed loop policy artifacts
items.context: Support UDM-* baseline ids, bounded loop policy/oracle artifacts, expected blocks, and suite acceptance locked behind Engineering evidence.
items.userSees: `node bin/lattice.js baseline_run --baselineId=UDM-EVIDENCE-GATE-1 --format=json` prints `"outcome":"EXPECTED_BLOCK"` with `"blockedReasons"` for missing evidence, plus loop policy and gate-result artifact paths.

happy.desc: Running Loop Engineering baselines writes loop-policy, gate-results, host-verdict, and final-report artifacts for UDM scenarios.

edge.desc: Evidence-gate and human-handoff scenarios block or escalate with explicit reasons until fresh evidence or human decision exists.

adversarial.desc: Open review loop, stale evidence, budget exhaustion, or same-host self-certification cannot reach PASS or DONE wording.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke verifies Loop Engineering command surface and artifact contracts are available through local baseline runner/report behavior.
UDM-EVIDENCE-GATE-1 returns EXPECTED_BLOCK with blocked reasons under local diagnostic mode until fresh evidence exists.
Smoke verifies stale evidence/schema drift/parallel proof substitution cannot unlock higher claims or PASS wording.

items.title: Implement Production Safety Baseline runner with authority/soak claim locks
items.context: Support SAFE/AUTH/PROD baseline ids, receipt and multi-host status artifacts, expected blocks for missing authority evidence, and no silent local fallback.
items.userSees: `node bin/lattice.js baseline_run --baselineId=AUTH-RECEIPT-1 --format=json` prints `"outcome":"EXPECTED_BLOCK"`, `"receiptVerified":false`, and `"productionDone":false` when no verified Authority receipt exists.

happy.desc: Production Safety runner emits SAFE/AUTH/PROD reports with authority, receipt, soak, and audit sections when scenarios are requested.

edge.desc: Authority mode off/shadow keeps receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false, and fullAuthorityDone=false while still allowing local report generation.

adversarial.desc: Missing receipt, stale verdict reuse, missing multi-host proof, or silent local fallback blocks and never flips authority fields true.

items.title: Implement Capability Claim evaluator and blocked claim reports
items.context: Read lower-layer suite reports and generate claim-report.json/md that authorizes only evidence-backed wording, blocks overclaim/non-authority/stale evidence, and preserves sequential unlock order.
items.userSees: `node bin/lattice.js capability_claim_evaluate --target=production-safety --format=json` prints `"authorized":false`, `"highestAuthorizedClaim"`, and blocked reasons naming missing lower-layer or authority evidence.

happy.desc: With valid lower-layer suite reports in order, `capability_claim_evaluate` authorizes only the highest evidence-backed claim and writes claim-report JSON/Markdown when output is requested.

edge.desc: Development-only evidence authorizes only the basic development claim and keeps Engineering/Loop/Production claims blocked.

adversarial.desc: Stronger-than-evidence, non-authority wording, missing receipt, or stale lower-layer report is rejected with `authorized=false` and explicit blocked reasons.

items.title: Add local tests and docs for Baseline 2-5 parallel implementation readiness
items.context: Tests must prove node bin/lattice.js exposes the commands, generated reports are internally consistent, higher-layer claims fail closed when lower layers are missing, and parallel implementation does not imply parallel proof.
items.userSees: `npm test`, local baseline command smoke tests, and claim-gate tests pass; generated reports show implementation may proceed in parallel while proof unlock remains sequential.

happy.desc: `npm --prefix packages/main run build`, local baseline smoke, and `npm test` pass after implementation.

edge.desc: Higher-layer implementation artifacts can exist in shadow/not_authorized state before lower-layer proof without unlocking claims.

adversarial.desc: Parallel implementation never implies parallel proof; stale evidence, schema drift, or local authority substitution fails closed in smoke tests.
